      A'' ⊆ A ∧

name: LeanProofs.GowersSzemeredi.LinearOn.two_anchor_interpolation

theorem LinearOn.two_anchor_interpolation {N : Nat} [Fact N.Prime]
    {A : Finset (ZMod N)} {f : ZMod N → ZMod N} (hf : LinearOn A f)
    {a b x : ZMod N} (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ A) (hx : x ∈ A) (hab : a ≠ b) :

      section16TranslatedVertex phi x0 vFT z =
        (firstFace3 x0).pullback phi (dropFirst (origPt x0 z)) ∧
      section16TranslatedVertex phi x0 (fun _ => false) z =
        (lastFace3 x0).pullback phi (lastPt3 (origPt x0 z))

      section16TranslatedVertex phi x0 vFT z =
